annotate: A marker stroke is drawn under the word, as if by hand.
annotate.strike: Struck through, with a shaky line.
attention: An attention call: the button does tada, then rests.
attention.rubber: It stretches like a rubber band.
attention.swing: The label swings, hanging from the top.
autosize: Add or remove a line: the box slides from one size to the other instead of jumping.
backlight: A glow (a halo) made of the image's own colors: a very blurry cloud of its own hues, behind it.
backlight.caption_glow: The glow passes behind the caption, which stays sharp.
backlight.wide_glow: A wide glow that spreads behind the image when you hover it.
bars: Bands reveal the tag one after the other.
beam: Beams of blurry light come in from a corner.
behind: The text passes behind the subject of the photo: a giant title, and the cut-out subject laid over it. Move the mouse: the relief shifts the subject and the background.
behind.blurred_edge: Near an edge, the uncovered strip shows the blurred photo.
behind.depth: The subject stays in front of the title; the landscape gains depth when the mouse moves.
behind.solid_edge: Near an edge, the uncovered strip shows a flat color.
blend: A blend mode, like in a photo editor: here, a flat orange fill blended with the image.
blend.difference: A title in difference inverts over what it covers: light on one side, dark on the other.
blend.overlay: Two blended images: the second covers the first in overlay.
blend.screen_gradient: A gradient blended in screen with the image.
blocks: A checkerboard of tiles that assemble while turning.
blocks.from_center: Tiles that arrive from the center toward the edges.
blocks.random_tiles: Sixteen columns by nine rows of tiles that arrive at random.
blocks.stripes: Bands that arrive row by row.
blur: The tag comes out of the blur, like a focus pull.
border: A gradient edge glow, and its halo.
border.run: A streak of light runs along the edges.
border.wave: The four edges cut into a scrolling lace.
chromatic: The color channels shift, red on one side and blue on the other; the gap grows on hover.
chromatic.cmy_title: On a title, in cyan, magenta and yellow.
circular: The text in a circle, spinning: a badge.
clay: Modeling clay: the card swells into relief.
count: The number counts up to its value, with your separators.
crossfade: The tag flies from one list to the other — click an item.
crt: An old CRT screen over a fake terminal: scanlines, a bright band moving down, flicker.
cube: The tag turns like the face of a cube.
cursors: Other visitors' cursors, with their names, through your app's MJS WS connection: their mouse and clicks, their selection, the tag they are on — everything by default, set like `*follow`. Move your mouse, click or select text in one screen: it shows up on the other. Here, a simulated server links the two screens, and Théo, a fictional visitor, wanders around too.
cycle: Words take turns in place of the written word, each one driving out the previous.
cycle.blur: The words come out of the blur.
cycle.frame: A glowing frame opens on each word, then closes.
cycle.typewriter: The words are typed as on a typewriter, with their cursor.
delta: A price that moves: it goes up, the cell flashes green ▲; it goes down, red ▼; and the number counts up to its new value.
dock: Move the mouse closer: the icon grows, its neighbors move aside.
draw: An SVG path draws itself, stroke after stroke.
extrude: A 3D relief under the text, which deepens.
fade: A fade: the tag appears, then disappears.
filter: A photo-editing workshop: 43 moods and special effects, ten fine settings and a drop shadow. The settings of a special effect only act on it: “levels” on posterize, “size” on pixelate…
filter.bright_hue_shift: Fine settings, no mood: written without a style, they act alone (all reset to their original value, the line becomes `*filter` again, the grey).
filter.cyberpunk: Midnight blue shadows and magenta highlights.
filter.frosted_glass: The photo is blurred everywhere, sharp under the mouse.
filter.gray_at_rest: Black and white at rest; hover: the colors come back.
filter.gray_spot: The photo is black and white, and gets its colors back under the mouse.
filter.halftone: A dot screen, like in a newspaper.
filter.lens: The text is blurred, except under a magnifier that follows the mouse.
filter.lomo: The look of lomo cameras: saturated colors, dark edges.
filter.pixelate: Big blocks: the image gets pixelated.
filter.posterize: Few color levels: the image becomes a poster.
filter.sepia_spot: A sepia photo that gets its colors back under the mouse, with a soft edge.
filter.thermal: A thermal camera: from cold blue to warm yellow.
filter.tiltshift: A sharp band in the middle, blurred top and bottom: a miniature.
filter.vignette: The edges of the image darken.
flash: The part that changes lights up for a moment (the same flash as the inspection panel). radius rounds the flash.
flip: A flip in place, like a card.
flipcard: A two-sided card that flips in 3D on hover: the first child is the front, the second the back.
flipcard.click_flip: Flipped with a click, around the horizontal axis.
fluid: A colored ink swirling under the mouse, at the back of the tag: move the mouse over it, or let it move on its own.
fluid.glow_rays: A pronounced halo and rays of light, in three colors.
fluid.ink_title: A big title filled with ink that moves on its own.
fluid.long_trail: An ink that lingers, with big swirls.
fluid.two_colors: A two-color ink that moves all by itself.
fly: The tag slides in, in the chosen direction (a word or an angle), and leaves the way it came.
fly.light_speed: At light speed: tilted and blurred, it straightens up as it arrives.
fly.rising_caption: A caption that rises from the bottom on hover.
fly.slide_left: On hover, the element slides to the left to appear.
fly.spin_in: The element arrives from the right, spinning once around itself, blurred at first.
focus: Focus on a group: hover a card, the others blur and the one you aim at stays sharp.
focus.dim_others: The others fade out, without blur.
focus.gray_others: The others turn black and white and step back, the one you aim at grows.
follow: The audience's screen follows the leader's scrolling: same part, cut at the same place, with a glow on arrival — through your app's MJS WS connection (followPackage on the server side). Here, a simulated server links the two panes: scroll the left one, click, select text. Everything is visible by default — cursor: your mouse appears on the right, with your name (pulse: a wave on each click); selection: what you select; focus: the button or field you are on gets outlined.
gallery: A gallery of panels arranged in 3D space, which you move forward: by dragging (try it), by scrolling, with the mouse or on their own — seven styles.
gallery.arc: An endless arc of panels that you drag.
gallery.free_wheel: A wheel you drag and that glides freely, with no notches.
gallery.sphere: A sphere of panels that turns with the mouse.
gallery.strip: A strip you drag: the panels close in toward the edges.
gallery.tunnel: You travel through the panels one after the other, without doing anything.
gallery.wheel: A wheel of panels that turns as you scroll.
gauge: The number fills up like a gauge, within its range (the one from its `<vars>` block, otherwise min and max, otherwise 0 to 100). Click + and −.
glass: Frosted glass: the card blurs whatever is behind it.
glitch: The title glitches in bursts; on a component or an image, the tag itself is shaken.
goo: The button bleeds: drops burst out and melt into a puddle.
goo.merge: The shapes fuse like liquid as they get close — move them: the bridge stretches, then breaks.
gradient: A color gradient scrolls through the letters, at the chosen angle.
gradient.knockout: Cut-out text: its letters are a window onto a scrolling gradient (or onto an image).
gradient.texture: The letters are filled with a moving pattern.
grid: Honeycomb cells: the one the mouse hovers lights up.
grid.glow: A glow follows the mouse under the grid.
grid.lines: A grid of fine lines, fading toward the bottom.
grid.needle: Compasses whose needle points to the mouse.
grid.outline: The hovered cells get an outline.
grid.rows: Each row has its own tint.
grid.trail: Cells light up as you pass and fall spinning.
guard: The field refuses a value outside its rule: it shakes its head "no" and says what is allowed. Type 300 and wait (delay), then leave the field.
heatmap: Where visitors click (or the chosen event): each point goes to the server, through your app's MJS WS connection, and the server turns them into a map, to read on the bridge's admin page (/heatmap). show also draws it on the area, live: all points, or the most recent ones. Here, a simulated server: click or move the mouse in the page below.
highlight: A highlighter passes behind the text.
ink: The image arrives like a spreading ink stain, among twenty styles: brush, smoke, frost, rain, maze… or your mask image.
ink.brush: Big brush strokes, one after the other.
ink.burn: Burning paper: a bitten edge, embers ahead.
ink.cells: A mosaic of cells lighting up one by one.
ink.dots: Dots that grow, like a newspaper halftone.
ink.drip: The paint runs down from the top.
ink.frost: Frost crystals growing from the edges.
ink.glitch: Blocks that break away in bursts.
ink.maze: A maze carved out, then its walls melt away.
ink.petals: A rosette of petals that opens.
ink.rain: Drops that slide and leave widening trails.
ink.scribble: A zigzag pencil stroke sweeping across the image.
ink.smoke: The image forms in a cloud.
ink.topo: Contour lines that thicken, like a topographic map.
ink.wash: A sheet of water soaking the paper.
iris: A circle opens and reveals the tag — from the center, or another point.
iris.from_click: On appearance, a round opening starts from where the pointer is.
iris.tilted_box: On scroll, a tilted rectangle straightens up as it opens.
iris.tilted_oval: On scroll, a slightly tilted oval opens.
iso: The icon becomes a cube seen from three quarters, which lifts up.
kenburns: The slow zoom of a drifting photo — the frame itself stays still.
lang: Switches language: the text scrambles then recomposes (or erases and types itself).
lift: The card lifts, with its shadow.
lift.pressed_key: A key that presses down when you push: its shadow tightens.
liquid: The image warps as if seen through water when you hover it.
liquid.red_ghost: A red ghost follows the tiles.
liquid.smooth_wave: A smooth wave, only around the pointer.
liquid.tiles: The image distorts into tiles around the mouse.
loader: A loading indicator: dots, a ring of beads that light up in turn.
loader.bloom: A flower of squares diving toward the center.
loader.neon: A neon arc that opens and closes while sliding.
loader.plus: A glowing cross whose arms pivot around the center.
loader.slab_ring: A gradient ring, carved into a raised slab.
loader.spiral: Bright dots streak along spokes: a spiral.
loader.steps: A dotted frame flips by quarters, a square folds inside it.
loader.trio: Three colored rings chasing each other.
longshadow: A long cast shadow that runs away from the mouse.
longshadow.lamp: With the lamp that follows the mouse.
magnet: The icon is attracted by the mouse.
magnet.ring: With the ring that grows around the icon.
marquee.columns: A column that rises as you scroll (here, inside its box).
marquee.text_pause: A big text that scrolls by itself and stops on hover.
marquee.thumbnails: Thumbnails that scroll on their own and follow your hand when you drag them.
marquee.wall: An edgeless wall of thumbnails that you drag in every direction.
matrix: A rain of characters falls at the back of the tag.
mesh: A background of large blurry color blobs drifting slowly, under the content.
mesh.aurora: An aurora of blurry colors that drifts.
mesh.candy: A candy palette: soft pinks and blues.
mesh.neon: A neon palette on a dark background.
mesh.ocean: An ocean palette: blues and turquoises.
mesh.sunset: A sunset palette: orange, pink, purple.
neon: A neon glow around the text, the frame, or both.
neon.breathing_red: A red neon whose glow swells, then tightens.
neon.pink_frame: A frame and its text, both pink, that breathe together.
noise: Film grain: without on the left, with on the right.
offline: When the network drops: a banner says so (and counts the changes that will be sent on return), the area grays out under a veil. Cut the network for fake with the button — the banner arrives after delay.
orbit: Icons spin in a circle and stay upright.
outline: The text as an outline, which fills in.
parallax: The tag slides at its own pace as you scroll (here, inside its box).
parallax.drift: It glides at its own pace from the top, and catches up when you stop.
particles.aura: Sparks shoot out under the button on hover; the red halo comes from a second effect, `*neon`, placed on the same button.
particles.network: Dots linked by threads; the mouse pushes them away, a click adds one.
path: A small arrow follows a path, turning with the curve: a ready-made path, your own, or an already drawn `<path>`.
peel: A page corner lifts and shows what is underneath: hover the top corner.
physics: The tag's children become solid bodies, a real physics simulation: they fall, bounce and pile up; grab them with the mouse and throw them.
physics.balloons: Balloons held by a string: gravity makes them rise.
physics.hanging_letters: Letters hung on a string: pull on them, let go.
physics.springy_cards: Cards held by a spring, which the mouse pushes around.
pile: Scroll: the panels stack up — each one rises, sticks at the top and covers the previous one, which shrinks.
pile.blurred: The covered card blurs, with rounded corners and a fixed bar at the top.
pile.deep: The covered card shrinks and darkens.
pile.offset: The cards overlap, leaving the top of each one visible.
pixelate: The image pixelates then sharpens in steps on entry; on exit, the reverse.
pixelate.big_pixels: Huge squares at the start, 160 px wide.
pixelate.scroll_mosaic: The mosaic sharpens as you scroll and breaks up again when you scroll back.
pixelate.three_steps: Only three steps, in big jumps.
pixels: Colored tiles fill the button, in random order.
pixels.card_burst: The card shatters and reveals its content.
pixels.explode: The sheet of tiles scatters on hover.
pixels.mosaic: The image is cut up, its tiles spin, then it puts itself back together.
pixels.strip: A curtain of thin bars moving up and down.
pixels.swap: On hover, the image gives way to another, tile by tile.
pointer: The viewer's cursor (their pointer): a disc follows the mouse with a slight delay, grows over what can be clicked and inverts the colors underneath.
pointer.blur_lens: A lens that blurs what it covers.
pointer.gray_lens: A lens that turns what it covers black and white.
pointer.pink_ring: A pink ring, with no color inversion.
pointer.soft_circle: The page is blurred, the sharp circle melts gently into the blur.
pointer.trailing_dot: A dot, and a ring that follows it with a delay.
pulse: A glowing ring beats around the button, or around the letters.
rainbow: Each letter takes a color from the list; the colors travel, or stay.
react: A click sends the emoji to every visitor of the page, as in a live show — through your app's MJS WS connection (reactionsPackage on the server side). Here, a simulated server in the page; Zora, a fictional visitor, sends her own too. direction and gravity: falling rain (down, 2), rising bubbles…
reflect: A mirror reflection under the image, fading out. It takes no space: keep some margin around it.
reflect.water: The reflection ripples like on water.
reveal: The tag rises from the shadow; on exit, it slides out of view.
ripple: A ripple starts from the touched point.
scale: The tag grows from a point — the center, a corner — while becoming opaque.
scale.zoom_out: A card twenty times too big shrinks down to its size, as you scroll.
scramble: The letters get shuffled, then settle back into place one by one.
scratch: A scratch card: scratch with the mouse or a finger, the prize appears underneath.
scratch.gold: A golden layer and a wider brush.
scrollprogress: A reading bar that advances with the scroll: scroll the article.
scrollprogress.glow_gradient: A gradient, a halo, a thicker bar.
scrollprogress.side_rail: A vertical bar on the right edge, on its rail.
scrub: A sequence of images (or a video) that advances with the scroll: scroll down and the sun crosses the sky; scroll back up and it returns.
scrub.on_hover: The image sequence advances with the mouse, from left to right, instead of with scrolling.
shake: A shake: check "when" as you would pass a variable to true.
shared: The shared element of a page transition: click a product — its thumbnail slides and grows to its place in the product page, the rest fades. "Back" does the reverse. Here, navigation is simulated; in an app, it is the router, with @viewTransition.
shatter: The image rebuilds from scattered tiles; on exit, it shatters.
shine.shimmer: A reflection of light sweeps across the text, in a loop.
skeleton: A silhouette that shimmers while waiting for the content.
slide: An accordion: the tag unfolds in height (or in width).
smoke: The mouse stirs up smoke inside the button.
sparkles: Sparks appear around the word and fade out.
spin: A continuous rotation, flat or in 3D.
split: The text splits into two halves that slide.
spoiler: A word hidden under grains: click it to reveal it.
spotlight: A light follows the mouse: a halo inside, a thin edge glow on the border.
spotlight.corner_flash: The same corner glow, golden, lighting up now and then.
spotlight.corner_glow: A permanent purple glow, without the mouse: it starts from the bottom left corner and spills into the box.
spotlight.dark_veil: A dark veil pierced by the light of the mouse: you only read in the light.
spotlight.green_torch: A flashlight: only the edge lights up under the mouse.
spotlight.hover_veil: The veil only appears on hover.
spotlight.lagging_halo: A sea-green halo that follows the mouse with a delay.
sprite: A sheet of poses animated in jumps, like a cartoon: here, a runner in eight poses, on two rows. The sheet is next to it: click it to see it full size.
sprite.burst_once: Twelve poses at sixteen per second, played once on arrival.
sprite.four_directions: A character with four directions (one row of the sheet each), in crisp pixels.
sprite.hover_two_frames: Two poses that alternate as long as the mouse stays over it.
sprite.spin_on_click: Sixteen poses played once on click: a coin doing a full turn.
stack: The card lifts up and reveals a stack of cards underneath.
stagger: The letters arrive one after another: slid, zoomed, flipped in 3D, blurred…
stagger.blur_words: Word by word, rather than letter by letter.
stagger.cards_in_row: The children (cards, photos) arrive one after the other.
stagger.flip: The letters flip in 3D one after the other.
stagger.masked_lines: A paragraph that rises line by line, from behind its edge.
stagger.menu_slide: A menu whose entries arrive one by one, from the left.
stagger.scroll_lines: The lines rise as you scroll.
stagger.scroll_words: Scroll: words light up one after another in the band from 80% to 30% of the box (zone), upcoming ones in grey (opacity).
stagger.title_words: A big title that rises word by word.
sticky: A sticky bar that freezes at the top after a scroll threshold and slides back in: scroll, and it follows you.
sticky.hiding_bar: Once stuck, the bar hides when you scroll down and comes back as soon as you scroll up.
sticky.reappearing_bar: Past 300 px of scrolling, the bar sticks to the top, sliding in.
swipe: A soft front sweeps over the tag and reveals it — in any direction.
tilt: The card tilts in 3D under the mouse; the reflection follows the pointer.
tilt.bounce_back: When the mouse leaves, the card waits, comes back overshooting its place, then settles.
tilt.floating_layers: Parallax: the character floats in front of the card.
tracking: The letters arrive spread apart and tighten, like a movie title.
travel: The tag travels to its destination — taking its place and size — as you scroll, and goes back if you scroll up.
travel.flip_card: It flips over as it travels, like a postcard heading to its frame.
travel.reveal: It keeps its size, and the destination only appears when it gets there.
travel.spin_path: It passes by spinning once around, on a curved path.
turn: A fold that pivots on its edge.
typewriter: The text is typed on a typewriter, then erased.
unveil: A color bar passes and reveals the text.
velocity: The tag reacts to the speed of the scroll: it leans when you go fast and returns to flat as soon as you stop. Scroll fast.
velocity.bend: The elements bulge like a sheet of paper (the costliest style).
velocity.lag: They lag behind their text, then catch up.
velocity.stretch: They stretch in the direction of a fast sideways scroll.
volet: The content slides in inside its own box, like a blind.
wave: The text is a glass that fills with water.
weight: The letter weight ripples: each letter thickens as the mouse approaches.
weight.stretch: Without a variable font, the letters stretch instead of getting bolder.
zoom: The image grows inside its frame, which stays still.
zoom.from_pointer: The image grows from the point under the mouse.
